title: Completion after fixing a coordinate list
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction on $n$ coordinates, let $L$ be a list of distinct coordinates, and let $x$ be a binary vector of length $n$. Suppose every coordinate in $L$ is free in $\rho$. Completing the restriction obtained by fixing the coordinates in $L$ according to the signs encoded by $x$, using $x$, gives the same sign vector as completing $\rho$ using $x$.
hypotheses_covered: the coordinates in the list are distinct
every listed coordinate is initially free
$x$ is a binary vector of length $n$
